decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The proposal is an over development of the site, through its size, scale, massing, density and layout, which results in a poor relationship to the northern and southern boundaries of the site and an inadequate amount of amenity space. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.2 (Residential Density) H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and policy 4.B.3 (Maximising potential of Sites) of the London Plan 2004

Condition : 2 - 2. The proposed design through its failure to provide adequate articulation, hierarchy and permeability, does not result in a development that would be of a sufficient quality of design, especially in relation to the River Thames and High Street. This is contrary to policies IMP.5.1 (High Quality Building and Urban Design) ENV.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.1.2 (High Buildings or Structures Affecting Sensitive Areas) ENV.W.1.1 (Design in the Thames Policy Area) of the Adopted London Borough Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2004 and policy 4C.20 (Design Starting From the Water) of the London Plan 2004.

Condition : 3 - 3) The proposed residential development fails to provide a sufficient percentage of affordable housing in relation to the number of units proposed. Policies H.3.5 (Release of Employment Use to Residential), H.4.3 (Residential Mix), and H.2.1 (Affordable Housing) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 4 - 4) The proposed relationship of the southern building to itself and to northern building would result in unacceptable living conditions for in terms of light, outlook and privacy.  This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2004.

Condition : 5 - 5) The development proposes a river walkway that would have no surveillance, resulting in a insecure and hostile environment for pedestrian users. This would be contrary to ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.1.9 (Safety and Security) and T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security)

Condition : 6 - 6) The application has not adequately demonstrated that the proposed access and the traffic generated from it, will not have an adverse affect upon the safety and free flow of traffic upon the highway network, especially in relation to the Ealing Road junction. This is contrary to policy T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of the Adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 7 - 7) The proposal through its failure to provide sufficient employment generating uses on the ground floor of the development fronting the High Street, does not provide an adequate mix of uses. This is contrary to policy E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses) of the Adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 8 - The proposal is within Flood Zone 3 and has failed to provide a flood risk assessment, in accordance with PPG25. This is contrary to policy ENV.W.2.4 of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Demolition of existing buildings and conversion and extension to existing buildings to form 72 residential units and ground floor restaurant with ancillary parking.
